premises.text: The space industry faces a problem with satellites running out of fuel and being destroyed.
premises.evidence_span: in the last decade, almost 200 satellites worth about $100 billion have had to be destroyed because they've run out of fuel.

premises.text: There is no existing system for safely and reliably fueling satellites in space.
premises.evidence_span: No system exists for safely and reliably fueling a satellite in space.

premises.text: OrbitFab is building gas stations in space to provide fuel to satellites.
premises.evidence_span: We're building gas stations in space.

premises.text: The fueling port developed by OrbitFab allows satellites to be refueled safely and reliably in orbit.
premises.evidence_span: This fueling port allows satellites to be refueled safely and reliably in orbit.

premises.text: OrbitFab's customers can save 50 percent on their capital expenditure.
premises.evidence_span: Our customers can save 50 percent on their capital expenditure.

premises.text: The fueling port is a drop-in replacement for existing fill ports used on satellites.
premises.evidence_span: this is a drop-in replacement, we're getting rapid customer adoption.

value.text: The space industry can recover lost revenue by refueling satellites in orbit.
value.evidence_span: we have the opportunity to recover billions of dollars of lost revenue.
